name: ca.swiftsign/mcp
description: Send, track, and download e-signed documents. Agent-first: mint a sandbox API key with one tool call (no account or browser), send PDFs with anchor or coordinate field placement, check status, and pull back the sealed PDF + Certificate of Completion. Live sends are confirm-gated for safety.

environmentVariables.name: SWIFTSIGN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SwiftSign API key (sk_test_ sandbox or sk_live_). Optional at startup: call the swiftsign_signup tool to mint a sandbox key, then set it.
